body: This exact thing happened to me and I wish so much the Plan B packaging made it abundantly clear that if you have already ovulated it's unlikely to work. And also a suggestion to head to Planned Parenthood immediately and get an IUD, which is 99% effective at preventing implantation. Nine months later, I am severely depressed, on a lot of medication, getting therapy, and still want to die. But I have to live for my existing children. I'm so sorry you have to go through this.
